title: Two ring-fusion branches. Four clerodane classes.
두 고리융합 분기, 네 clerodane 계열.
intro: Follow the dotted classification lines: cis-decalin cores group cis–cis and cis–trans clerodanes; trans-decalin cores group trans–cis and trans–trans clerodanes. These lines classify structures; they do not depict conversion of free decalin into a diterpene.
점선은 구조 분류입니다. cis-decalin 골격에는 cis–cis와 cis–trans, trans-decalin 골격에는 trans–cis와 trans–trans clerodane이 묶입니다.

edges.detail: Clerodane includes the C1–C10 decalin core plus a six-carbon side chain and four additional carbons; absolute stereochemistry is not assigned by this parent name.
